name: Reach Letters
summary: A contact menu spelled REACH where each letter swells under the cursor and opens a way to reach you
about: A playful contact menu for a portfolio or personal site. The big serif word REACH drops in letter by letter, then works like a dock: letters swell and lean toward the cursor as it passes. Each letter squishes when pressed, wobbles happily and flips open a small card for your resume, email, studio address, phone number or a quick hello note, and the copy, download and send buttons all work.
how: Move the mouse along the word: the letter under the cursor grows the most and its neighbours lean in.
Click, tap or press Enter on a letter: it squishes, wobbles and a card flips down under the word with a pointer aimed at it.
Use the card: download the resume as a text file, copy the email, address or number, or type and send a short hello.
Click the same letter, the close button or press Escape to fold the card away.
